answers: read over the NPC's own record: #93 facts, their group's #270 standing, the tone just used, and what THEY personally witnessed or were told (#272 reports as knowledge). NPCs answer from what they know and can be wrong like people. Refusals are answers with content
laneFence: GAME-SIDE HUMANS ONLY. The show's laws do not apply here (show creatures cries-only, subtitles rare — in the show). The fence runs both ways: in the game, Mochi do not speak either — cries (#2) and #152 presence. No game-side #136 exists and this machinery may never grow one

options.derivation: derived at read time from a closed fact list: the NPC's #93 record, the Ranger's #12 facts, #93/#280 relationship facts, #299 membership (when worn or known, per #299's rule), the room's #270 standing
options.law: an option whose fact is absent is not greyed out — it is NOT THERE. No option source may be added outside the list without a proposal into #301's file
options.noTextStore: #12's pointer-only pairing stands: this spec founds no text store; every line is a #23 lookup

standingRule: reputation colours the room, not the ruling (#270's licence-trial rule generalised): story-critical services answer under their own story flags (#139 story-locked class); standing changes framing, never the spine's availability
storage: nothing but facts: #12 beats set, deeds/reports earned. No dialogue log, no relationship-points number, no dialogue skill

toneClasses.availability: reads #271 standing: authority opens at high bands in rooms that hold you high; threat/bluff open in the deep bad bands (and in rooms that fear you); kind/plain are everyone's floor. A feared Ranger's menu differs from a beloved one's MECHANICALLY, not by authoring two dialogues
toneClasses.effect: tone is a deed-class input: the answer and any witnessed #269/#270 consequence run through the real systems (a threat before the town is a #272-witnessed fact)
toneClasses.status: vocabulary is system data (tunable); lines are #23 content
